name: Tomer
about:
I'm a computer scientist with a focus on AI, autonomy, and real-world impact. Currently, I serve as the frontier AI lead at the Department of the Navy through the NobleReach Scholars program, where I help shape the Navy’s AI adoption strategy for over 650,000 personnel. My work spans from technical strategy and stakeholder analysis to policy development and capability evaluation. 

 I’m drawn to hard, ambiguous problems—especially the kind that sit at the intersection of emerging tech and public good. I thrive in interdisciplinary teams, enjoy translating between technical and non-technical domains, and believe the best ideas come from building fast and thinking critically.
